items.pregunta: Are secret values referenced from a secret store or injected at deploy time, never written literally in Terraform variables, manifests, compose files or chart values?
items.evidencia: The line that sets each credential, key or password

items.pregunta: Are admin, debug, metrics and database ports kept off public ingress, public load balancers and 0.0.0.0/0 rules?
items.evidencia: The ingress, service, port mapping or security group rule that exposes the port

items.pregunta: Are new buckets and object stores private (public access blocked, no public ACL or anonymous policy) unless the PR states the content is public?
items.evidencia: The bucket ACL, public access block or policy statement

items.pregunta: Do the roles and policies grant only the actions and resources the workload uses, with no wildcard action or resource over data stores, secrets or IAM?
items.evidencia: The Action and Resource entries of each policy

items.pregunta: Do the containers run without privileged mode, host network or PID namespaces, hostPath mounts, the container runtime socket or added capabilities?
items.evidencia: The securityContext, privileged, volumes and cap_add entries

items.pregunta: Does the proxy or ingress strip client-supplied identity headers (X-Forwarded-For, user or client-certificate headers) before the backend trusts them?
items.evidencia: The header directives of the proxy and the backend code that reads those headers
